question: In which of the following states is the Ajanta caves situated?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Maharashtra**__.

__
 
• The **Ajanta caves** are situated in **Maharashtra**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• The Ajanta Caves are approximately **30 rock-cut Buddhist cave** monuments dating from the 2nd century BCE to about 480 CE.
 
• The Ajanta caves are situated in the **Aurangabad district** of Maharashtra.
 
• The figures in these caves were done using **fresco painting**.
 
• The paintings are generally themed around **Buddhism – the life of Buddha and Jataka stories**.
 
• The outlines of the paintings were done in **red colour**.
 
• One of the striking features is the **absence of blue colour** in the paintings.
 
• The caves were designated a UNESCO Heritage site in 1983.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/df36bf74acc1cbc8c4b71ea4c288afe5a5510688e26ae8e07c3f8cae5617ce45.png]
